when: An unclear subject or a gap changes structure or format
recommendation: Ask only for the missing consequential information; preserve supplied facts and mark demo data. A complete brief proceeds without another approval.
Search the catalog, inspect at most two entries, choose a suitable structure and reuse working assets. A template's appearance yields to the visual contract.

when: Before choosing a method for an open composition
recommendation: Consider a generated visual proposal, an existing reference, and direct implementation. Discover actual generation and image-viewing tools separately. Unknown availability is not unavailability. Never force generation or change providers.

when: A brand source, named design system or existing product applies
recommendation: Extract actual values, preserve project components and bind the real theme. Otherwise author a subject-specific design spec. brand-kit.mjs renders a supplied brand.json; it does not discover a brand.

when: Images, real referents or photography carry meaning
recommendation: Reuse correct supplied assets; source real named referents, never invent replacements. images.mjs search/get localizes licensed images and credits. Generated imagery is a separate authorized capability.

when: Native apps, multiple targets, device frames or prototypes
recommendation: Use platform conventions and real component contracts. Device frames are removable presentation; preserve safe areas, keyboard and navigation behavior within scope.

when: Documents for paper, PDF or diagrams
recommendation: Use actual page dimensions, readable print typography and an appropriate diagram representation; distinguish browser verification from physical print proofing.

when: Related screens, reusable components, editor artifacts or retained feedback
recommendation: Reuse a real shared model/component and verify a change in every affected instance. Use the actual editor renderer. Keep confirmed preferences separate from hypotheses.

when: Data changes decisions, totals, availability or states
recommendation: Use one implementation with explicit contrasting input fixtures and its preview adapter (--scenario). Check boundaries and meaning; a clean screenshot alone proves neither.

when: An artifact can be shown or revised
recommendation: preview.mjs serves only the intended artifact directory, reloads files and records comments against stable data-craft-id values. Resolve comments after applying changes; a preview does not publish the work.

when: Before delivery and after changing the final artifact
recommendation: Run inspect.mjs at requested sizes and view the resulting PNGs. --fit enforces no scroll; --contract checks readiness/content/runtime; --mode desktop preserves narrow fixed artboards. shot.mjs only captures. Review findings require judgment.

when: Building or changing an HTML theme
recommendation: tokens.mjs check tests literals and actual token effects; extract/sync share a theme; import converts supported token JSON and rejects unsupported input. Run the check, resolve findings and preserve the source theme.

when: Completing a task or refining existing work
recommendation: Keep scope, editability and content. Run verify.mjs at all affected widths together. When passed:false, repair current diagnostics and repeat; report counts from the latest source-bound results. View final PNGs. Runtime unavailability is incomplete verification, not a quality pass.
